title: Code native customer QA coverage
claim: C01-C07 are evidenced bounded cases; this is not full Code-module or full customer QA certification.
evidence_basis: Actual native evidence JSON and final mobile PNG from candidate82 evidence directory; no inference from unit tests.

coverage: literal HTML-like markup and entities remain text
quotes, apostrophe, backtick, line comment, block comment, blank line, final newline
empty Code content with filename/Copy enabled omits wrapper, code and copy control at all 3 devices after reload
scenarios.expected_dom: FIGURE containing escaped code markup; htmlElements=0; text equals authored source
Code text remains exact; Plain text has zero token spans; highlighted languages expose expected pc-c-* token classes

coverage: empty original clipboard restored as empty text
long sample with blank line and final empty line
Mobile controls-off removes header, copy button and line spans after reload
scenarios.expected_dom: wrap off uses white-space pre and scrolls without site overflow; wrap on uses pre-wrap; copy output equals source

scenarios.area: Base style and syntax token colors
coverage: Mobile authored padding observed as 12px 13px and size 13px
scenarios.expected_dom: Figure/pre computed style and token spans match recorded colors and dimensions
scenarios.limitation: Plain text token controls are absent by design and separately evidenced; arbitrary values, all units, all colors and every state are not exhausted.

coverage: all five token controls absent/effectively unused for Plain text
scenarios.expected_dom: Plain text produces zero token spans

coverage: reset restores all four values to Desktop inheritance
scenarios.expected_dom: Computed styles match each breakpoint, then all breakpoints inherit Desktop values after reset
scenarios.limitation: This records the bounded values exercised; it does not prove every breakpoint/state/control combination.

coverage: outline, relative position, top 3px, overflow visible, max-width 100%
each device hide switch retains code in DOM and changes display
matching condition keeps wrapper and code
scenarios.expected_dom: Advanced identity and computed style values are present; visibility uses retained DOM with display none; conditions control wrapper and Code presence
scenarios.limitation: Only the recorded condition/visibility matrix and representative Advanced values are evidenced.

unverified_gaps: Shared/common style controls outside the recorded Code cases.
Hover and keyboard Focus state values and rendering.
Motion, transition, animation, duration, delay, easing and once behavior.
Arbitrary values, all units, all fonts and exhaustive token colors.
Every editor create/edit/save/reload path and all drag/drop or insertion paths.
CMS bindings, dynamic component properties, variants, collection contexts and integrations.
Physical devices, alternate engines and broader customer workflows.
The new shorthand padding inspector control's native post-fix acceptance remains root-owned.

pre_fix_padding_observation.details: Code and Table padding inspector inputs were blank number fields while published computed values were Code 16px 18px and Table 10px 12px; values were restored after capture. Post-fix native acceptance remains root-owned.

findings: Code and Table defaults show complete shorthand text fields with computed parity at Desktop/Mobile.
Code invalid draft remains unsaved; blur/Enter error is linked; typing stays quiet in final timing evidence.
Table full-row layout is captured at Desktop/Mobile; mixed units, zero, invalid/negative, responsive reset and reload are recorded.
final_padding_native.limit: This is bounded native setting/layout evidence only; gallery, full-suite, deployment and broader customer QA remain separate acceptance gates.
